command: taskset -c 8-25 iverilog -g2012 -s tb_aha_garnet_proc_packet_writer -o work/results/l2_aha_proc_packet_writer.vvp rtl/integration/aha_garnet_proc_packet_writer.sv tb/tb_aha_garnet_proc_packet_writer.sv && taskset -c 8-25 vvp work/results/l2_aha_proc_packet_writer.vvp
success_condition: One 512-bit beat becomes eight low-word-first consecutive proc-packet writes, with no invented Global Buffer address translation.
failure_policy: If packing or addresses differ, compare against ProcDriver_write_data/ProcDriver_write_bs; preserve the caller-supplied packet base instead of deriving it from a CGRA lane ID.
